name: Pull, Then Pass
hint: A drop shot can pull a balanced defender forward. What becomes weak next?
lesson: Drop changes the defender to Forward. Forward reach is weak behind them.

name: Back, Then Short
hint: Move them deep first, then look at the front of the court.
lesson: Lob creates Back stance. Back reach is weak near the net.

name: Change Direction
hint: Stretch them to one side. The same idea can attack the space they just abandoned.
lesson: Cross creates a stretched stance and opens the opposite side.

name: Heavy Ball
hint: A hard drive may not score, but it can shrink the next Reach.
lesson: Drive applies Pressure. A pressured defender loses diagonal coverage for one shot.

name: Too Far Forward
hint: Do not move them first. Read what they cannot cover now.
lesson: Forward stance leaves the back row outside Reach.

name: Pinned Deep
hint: The defender is already deep. Punish the space in front.
lesson: Back stance leaves the front row outside Reach.

name: Wrong-Footed
hint: Their weight is already committed to the right side.
lesson: A stretched defender cannot reverse direction across the court in one response.

name: Open The Diagonal
hint: First reduce the defender's reach, then use an angled landing square.
lesson: Pressure turns diagonal cells into Weak Zones.

name: One Weak Beat
hint: The defender is already pressured. Find a legal landing square outside the smaller Reach.
lesson: Weak Zones are not special tiles. They are simply legal targets outside current Reach.

name: Checkrally Exam
hint: Read Reach first. Create a weakness before trying to score.
lesson: Every shot is a way to reshape the next reachable space.
